description: Estimate what an Indian Instagram or YouTube creator charges per deliverable, in INR, from their follower count and (optionally) average likes, comments, views and niche. Returns a price per product (Reel, Story, post, package; or YouTube integration, dedicated video, Short) when engagement figures are given, a low-high range when they are not, and the method behind it either way. Uses only the numbers you pass in: it looks nothing up. Accounts below the minimum scale are not priced, and the answer says why.

avg_comments.description: Average comments on recent posts or videos.

avg_likes.description: Average likes on recent posts or videos. Without it the answer is a range, not a price.

avg_views.description: YouTube only: average views on recent videos. Engagement on YouTube is measured against views, not subscribers.

followers.description: Followers on Instagram, subscribers on YouTube.

niche.description: What the creator posts about, in a few words (e.g. "beauty", "personal finance", "tech reviews").

platform.description: Where the creator posts. Instagram or YouTube.

name: estimate_rate
title: Estimate a creator's rate (INR)
